Four Naga civilians killed in Manipur ambush, bodies retrieved

Four Naga civilians were killed in an ambush in Manipur, and their bodies were retrieved. The incident occurred in Manipur, and security forces recovered the bodies. A Congress leader from Manipur stated that the central government cannot be a spectator to the killings.
